visual_identity.core_identity: An oversized beetle with a heavy oval shell and prominent luminous gland structures that remain recognizable in black-and-white line art.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low oval beetle body, domed wing cases, six stout legs, short antennae, broad head.
visual_identity.head_features: Compact insect head with mandibles, short antennae, and distinct rounded gland bulges near the head.
visual_identity.body_shape: Three-part insect body with hard domed elytra, six legs, and compact abdomen.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly six insect legs attached to the thorax; no spider leg count, mammal paws, or humanoid limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Large smooth armor plates with restrained segment lines; gland areas outlined clearly rather than shaded.

accuracy_checks: no extra fantasy anatomy obscures beetle identity

known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly six stout insect legs and domed elytra
restore heavy mandibles, broad head, and predatory beetle proportions

known_failure_modes.correction: show gland shape through outline and keep surrounding page open

scene_identity.size_impression: Small but oversized insect, large enough for shell and legs to read clearly against mine or tunnel features.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Low and fully supported on six legs while foraging or climbing.
behavior_style: pausing beside a large tunnel feature
environment_fit: ore chambers and rocky underground workspaces
